mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.perms FROM sys_user_role ur INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id INNER JOIN sys_permission p ON p.id = rp.perm_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 AND p.deleted = 0 AND p.status = 1 AND p.perms IS NOT NULL AND p.perms <> '' ORDER BY p.perms
